statement: For every integer M>=20 with M congruent to 4 modulo 8, the full order gadget OG(M) of Definition 15 is infeasible. More strongly, AP-freeness is already incompatible with the four precedence constraints C4={t_13 preceding b_1, t_11 preceding b_2, t_5 preceding b_5, t_10 preceding b_3}.
contribution: A uniform human-readable proof of the source-supported open residue class. The proof derives b_5 preceding b_3 from the second and fourth C4 attacks, then uses a generalized phase-blind flood lemma on 8-ladders, split across M modulo 16, to show that orientation is incompatible with the first and third attacks. Exact schema checks and two independent finite encodings corroborate but do not replace the universal argument.
